description: This file defines the PHP class 'CodeGuruSecurityClient' which extends 'AwsClient'. It serves as a client interface to interact with the Amazon CodeGuru Security service, providing method signatures for various API calls related to security findings, scans, metrics, and resource management.

classes.name: CodeGuruSecurityClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with Amazon CodeGuru Security service, providing methods for managing findings, scans, and configurations.

methods.name: batchGetFindings
methods.description: Retrieves details for multiple findings in a batch.

methods.name: batchGetFindingsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details for multiple findings in a batch.

methods.name: createScan
methods.description: Initiates a new scan within the service.

methods.name: createUploadUrl
methods.description: Creates an upload URL for uploading scan data.

methods.name: getFindings
methods.description: Retrieves findings based on specified parameters.

methods.name: getScan
methods.description: Gets details of a specific scan.

methods.name: getScanAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets details of a specific scan.

methods.name: listScans
methods.description: Lists scans associated with the account.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
